story_description: Parse and normalize Codex CLI JSON-RPC streaming events into Blaze NormalizedEvent enum
task_description: Create mapper struct that converts Codex JSON-RPC notification methods to NormalizedEvent cases
atom_description: Define CodexEventMapper struct with static map function that pattern-matches Codex method strings to NormalizedEvent enum cases
problem_statement: Codex CLI emits JSON-RPC notifications with different method names than Claude Code. Blaze needs a unified NormalizedEvent enum to render UI consistently. CodexEventMapper bridges this gap by translating Codex-specific methods to the shared event model.
scope_in: Map Codex item/completed with type agentMessage to AssistantComplete
Map Codex item/completed with type tool to ToolCallComplete
Map Codex item/reasoning events to ThinkingDelta
assumptions: Codex CLI emits JSON-RPC 2.0 notifications via stdout in stream-json mode
NormalizedEvent enum already exists with required cases
Codex method strings are stable across CLI versions
constraints: Must be pure Swift with no external dependencies
Pattern matching must be exhaustive with unknown method fallback
Mapper must be stateless for thread safety
functional_requirements: FR1: CodexEventMapper.map takes raw Codex JSON-RPC notification and returns optional NormalizedEvent
FR2: Method string item/agentMessage/delta maps to AssistantDelta with delta text extracted from params
FR3: Method string item/completed with params.type agentMessage maps to AssistantComplete
FR4: Method string item/started maps to ToolCallStarted with tool name and call ID from params
FR5: Method string item/completed with params.type tool maps to ToolCallComplete with output
FR6: Method string turn/started maps to SessionStarted
FR7: Method string turn/completed maps to SessionEnded
FR8: Method string turn/plan/updated maps to TurnPlanUpdated with plan steps array
FR9: Method string thread/tokenUsage/updated maps to TokenUsage with input and output counts
FR10: Method string account/rateLimits/updated maps to RateLimitsUpdated
FR11: Method strings matching item/reasoning prefix map to ThinkingDelta
FR12: Method string item/commandExecution/outputDelta maps to ToolOutputDelta
FR13: Method string item/fileChange/outputDelta maps to FileDiffDelta
FR14: Unknown method strings return nil with debug log
nonfunctional_requirements: NFR1: Mapping latency under 1ms per event
NFR2: No heap allocations for common event paths
implementation_steps: Step 1: Create CodexEventMapper.swift in Blaze/Sources/Engine/Adapters/Codex directory
Step 2: Define CodexEventMapper struct with static map function signature
Step 3: Implement switch statement on method string with all known Codex methods
Step 4: Extract params from JSON-RPC notification for each case
Step 5: Construct appropriate NormalizedEvent case with extracted data
Step 6: Add default case returning nil with os_log debug message
Step 7: Add unit tests for each mapping case
Step 8: Add edge case tests for malformed params and unknown methods
data_model_changes: No schema changes; uses existing NormalizedEvent enum
api_contracts: CodexEventMapper.map(notification: CodexNotification) -> NormalizedEvent? where CodexNotification has method: String and params: [String: Any]
event_contracts: Input: Codex JSON-RPC notification with method and params fields
Output: NormalizedEvent enum case or nil for unknown methods
item/completed type=agentMessage -> AssistantComplete(messageId: String, fullText: String)
item/started -> ToolCallStarted(toolName: String, callId: String, input: Any?)
item/completed type=tool -> ToolCallComplete(callId: String, output: Any?, error: String?)
item/fileChange/outputDelta -> FileDiffDelta(callId: String, delta: String, filePath: String)
edge_cases: Unknown method string returns nil without crashing
Missing params field returns nil with warning log
Malformed params missing required fields returns nil with error log
Method string with unexpected prefix returns nil
Params with wrong types for expected fields returns nil with type mismatch log
failure_modes: JSON parsing failure upstream prevents mapper invocation
Memory pressure during high event volume could cause drops
Type casting failures for params values
rollback_plan: Delete CodexEventMapper.swift and test file. No other components depend on it yet since Codex adapter is not wired.

unit: Test item/agentMessage/delta maps to AssistantDelta with correct text
Test item/completed with agentMessage type maps to AssistantComplete
Test item/started maps to ToolCallStarted with tool name
Test item/completed with tool type maps to ToolCallComplete
Test turn/plan/updated maps to TurnPlanUpdated with steps
Test thread/tokenUsage/updated maps to TokenUsage with counts
integration: N/A - mapper is stateless and tested via unit tests
ui: N/A - pure backend mapper with no UI
security: N/A - mapper does not handle auth or secrets

notes: CodexEventMapper is a pure function mapper with no side effects. It extracts the method string and params from Codex JSON-RPC notifications and constructs the appropriate NormalizedEvent case. The mapper is intentionally stateless to allow concurrent use across multiple sessions.

Params structure may vary between Codex versions
mitigations: Version check in adapter can select appropriate mapper
Graceful fallback to nil for unknown params shapes

risk_register.fallback_plan: Return nil for all events and log warnings; UI shows raw JSON fallback
